skill_name: Present a plan to help reduce food waste
workflow: A plan to reduce food waste would include multiple strategies. Firstly, implementing more efficient inventory tracking systems in order to reduce overstocking and reduce the amount of food that goes to waste. Secondly, rethinking packaging size and making the right portion size available to the customers. Thirdly, promoting the donations of excess food to those in need.
